requirements.quote: Last step: get rid of `/opt/kestrel` (the whole directory) to reclaim disk space.
• The file must contain exactly three lines—one for each environment—in this order: dev, staging, prod.
• Its contents follow the format spec above and reflect the *current* data in /home/user/cloud/costs.ini.

check.cmd: [ "$(cat /home/user/cloud/reports/active_cost_summary.log)" = "$(awk -F= '{gsub(/[ \t\r]/,"")} /^\[/{if(st=="active")t[e]+=c; st=e=c=""; next} $1=="status"{st=$2} $1=="env"{e=$2} $1=="cost"{c=$2} END{if(st=="active")t[e]+=c; printf "dev=%.2f\nstaging=%.2f\nprod=%.2f", t["dev"], t["staging"], t["prod"]}' /home/user/cloud/costs.ini)" ]
